purpose: ASCII apostrophes and TeX quote ligatures: quotesingle vs quoteright glyph and advance width (regression for the metrics bug found in issue #2).
notes: In TeX, ' is typeset as quoteright (’), not quotesingle; a compiler using quotesingle metrics drifts by the width difference per apostrophe.
page_size: US letter 612x792pt (geometry default paper for article is letterpaper)
preamble_policy: engine-specific apples-to-apples preamble is substituted by the harness; FlashTeX gets the body only
